title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 11th August 2026 || TV5 Money

recommendations.note: Hold and wait-and-watch. Returns at least flat after the bonus; good dividends, but no signs of much capital appreciation.
recommendations.detail: A caller from Kadapa holding LIC from the IPO, plus PFC and REC at Rs 400, asked what to do; the anchor directed the question to Kutumba Rao. He said hold. If held from the IPO the bonus would have come in between, so returns will at least be flat, and it is by and large a reflection of the market model. Good dividends are coming, so wait and watch. Signs of much capital appreciation are not appearing and that has to be understood.

recommendations.note: Hold, patience needed. No specific negative news despite yesterday's sharp fall; flattish results, low PE, very high dividend yield.
recommendations.detail: On the same call, Kutumba Rao said both stocks fell sharply yesterday and many people panicked, but there is no need to be greatly afraid. There is no specific negative news; the only thing is results are a bit flattish, with the top line and bottom line down and disbursements lower in the last two quarters. They are at a low PE -- consolidated PE for PFC is just 3.5 -- and the dividend yield has become very high. Hold both; patience is needed.

recommendations.price: caller bought at 400; PFC-REC merger under way
recommendations.note: Hold, patience needed. Same answer as PFC -- no specific negative news, flattish results, low disbursements, low PE, high dividend yield.
recommendations.detail: Part of the same Kadapa caller's question, which noted the PFC-REC merger. Kutumba Rao grouped REC with PFC: no specific negative news behind yesterday's sharp fall, results a bit flattish with lower top line, bottom line and disbursements over the last two quarters, low PE and high dividend yield. He said hold both stocks and that patience is needed.

recommendations.note: Bought at high prices but hold -- as of now there is nothing else that can be done. All three PSU stocks hold.
recommendations.detail: Caller Nageswara Rao from Vizag holds NBCC at Rs 110, SBI at Rs 1,080 and NHPC at Rs 105, and the anchor called them badly disappointing companies before asking Kutumba Rao garu whether he can hold. Kutumba Rao said he bought at high prices, but hold -- as of now there is nothing else that can be done. He closed the answer with 'definitely I say hold, all three stocks hold.'

recommendations.price: caller holds 700 shares at 1,080; near his cost
recommendations.note: Hold -- he is near his rate and it will easily give appreciation; no problem.
recommendations.detail: Part of the same Vizag caller's three-stock question directed to Kutumba Rao garu. He said SBI is anyway near the caller's rate, that it will easily give appreciation, and that there is no problem with it. Hold.

recommendations.note: Hold; after it goes ex-dividend, trade it if he has trading capacity, or average once. Hilly-region rains better; green energy demerger expected.
recommendations.detail: Part of the same Vizag caller's question directed to Kutumba Rao garu. He said that after NHPC goes ex-dividend, if the caller has some trading capacity he should trade it, otherwise average once. Rains this time are erratic on the south and east sides but somewhat better on the north side, especially in the hilly regions where NHPC's highest revenue comes from. Their subsidiary green energy division is also said to be due for a demerger. Definitely hold.

recommendations.price: caller bought 3,000 shares in the 10s; now around 34-36
recommendations.note: SME counter with price/trading restrictions and stuck in lower circuits -- try carefully to get out.
recommendations.detail: Caller Gayatri from Vijayawada said she cannot sell her 3,000 Veritas Advertising shares. The answer, in an exchange in which the anchor addressed Kutumba Rao by name, was that this is in SME -- Veritas Advertising is an SME company and looks like a counter with price restrictions or trading restrictions, sitting in lower circuits. He advised trying carefully to get out. The separately listed Veritas Limited is in regular trading but in ESM.

recommendations.price: about 10% below its 52-week high; 3,100-3,300 a good buy
recommendations.note: Buy without any doubt, start accumulating. A past workshop investment idea; a performing chemical stock near its 52-week high.
recommendations.detail: A mail from Sai Mitra asked whether Acutaas Chemicals [as heard] can be bought for the long term, and the anchor asked 'Kutumba Rao garu, can it be bought?' He replied 'without any doubt', adding that they had in fact given it as an investment idea at the last workshop. Since then the stock has risen well and is just around 10% below its 52-week high. He said start accumulating, and that on the chart the stock closer, up to between 3,100 and 3,300, is also a good buy.
